description: Curated proxy photo standing in for one feces crop from the assessed video. The expected demo class is a curation hint for deterministic demo profiles only; it is not a laboratory or PCR-confirmed label and never overrides the model's own output.
source_dataset: Poultry Diseases Dataset (farm-labelled images), Machuve et al., Zenodo
attribution: Machuve, D., Nwankwo, E., Mduma, N., Mbelwa, J. (2021). Poultry Diseases Dataset [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4628934. CC BY 4.0.
substitution_reason: The whole-pen detector is a deterministic mock, so no real crop is cut from assessed footage. This curated photo is deterministically selected as the appearance-classifier input instead; it did NOT come from the assessed video.
